register: Informal tú throughout (about 460 strings use tú/tu/tus vs about 24 with usted/su), which is standard for consumer apps in neutral Spanish; usted forms and strings that mix tú and usted are flagged (medium). Buttons and menu items use the infinitive or a noun phrase (Guardar, Añadir sitio, Marcar como leído); instructions in running text use the tú imperative (Introduce, Elige, Haz clic). Neutral Spanish for Spain and Latin America: no vosotros, no regional words (ordenador/computadora → dispositivo or equipo, móvil/celular → teléfono, coger, vale).

terms.note: The catalog mixes historia (≈670), artículo (≈270) and noticia (≈180). Historia is a calque of 'story' (it reads as history/tale or Instagram stories) and noticia is too narrow (feeds also carry blog posts, podcasts and newsletters); artículo is what Spanish RSS readers use (Feedly, Inoreader) and what iOS mostly uses already. Artículo is masculine, so the switch changes agreement: el/este/un artículo, artículos guardados/compartidos/leídos/ocultos/agrupados, del artículo, al artículo, and later pronouns (la → lo). Compounds: lista de artículos, título del artículo, vista de artículo, entrenador de artículos, agrupación de artículos. 'noticias' stays where the English says news (lector de noticias, Río de noticias).

avoid: web (as a noun for a site)
terms.note: Página is fine for a single web page (page scraping, a page's HTML).

Catalog plurality (≈375 feed vs ≈150 fuente and 20 canal) and the usual term in Spanish RSS readers. Masculine: el feed, un feed, del feed, este feed. Compounds: feed RSS, feed web, título del feed, lista de feeds, vista de feed. 'fuente' stays only for a source that is not a feed (cluster source cards, the source of an article) and 'fuente' for a font.
Parent folder → carpeta superior (not carpeta padre).
Both are natural; do not churn between them. Unread only → Solo no leídos; Next unread story → Siguiente artículo sin leer.

avoid: Leer noticias / Leer historias (for the Read Stories folder)
terms.note: 'Read Stories' is the folder of stories already read: Artículos leídos, never the imperative. Siri/Spotlight 'Read %@' opens a feed to read it: Leer %@. Mark newer/older as read → Marcar los más recientes/anteriores como leídos.
Unsave → Quitar de guardados (iOS already uses it); Unsave this story → Quitar este artículo de guardados.
A share as a noun: '%d shares' → '%d veces compartido' or 'compartido %d veces'; Delete share → Dejar de compartir / Eliminar lo compartido.
Product name, never translated; follow the English capitalization.
Intelligence training → entrenamiento de inteligencia; Train this story → Entrenar este artículo; Story trainer → entrenador de artículos; Site trainer → entrenador del sitio.

Slider: Todo / No leído / Enfoque. Capitalized as the name of the mode/level: modo Enfoque, vista Enfoque, artículos de Enfoque, No leídos + Enfoque. In prose 'focus on what matters' may stay 'centrarse en'.

terms.use: Me gusta / No me gusta; Hide → Ocultar
terms.note: Hide is the level above Like (formerly Super dislike, then No me gusta nada): Ocultar, quoted in sentences («Ocultar» gana a todo). The trainer's 'beats' means Like outranks Dislike: gana a / tiene prioridad sobre. '(like wins)' → (gana Me gusta). Thumbs up/down in prose may stay pulgar arriba/abajo.

Hide is the strongest training level, above Like and Dislike (it was called Super dislike): a story that matches it is always hidden, whatever else it matches. Use the same word as the Hide button in the training controls, and quote it in sentences like the other level names («Ocultar» gana a todo). The old Super dislike names are retired.
Prompt classifier → clasificador por instrucciones; Regex classifiers → clasificadores regex.

terms.use: Premium / Premium Archive / Premium Pro / Archive / Pro
terms.note: Plan names stay in English as product names, matching the App Store and Play Store products and the German decision (catalog is split 29 Archivo Premium vs 27 Premium Archive). In Spanish the translated 'Archivo Premium' collides with the story archive feature (archivo de artículos). Use 'el plan Archive/Pro' where an article is needed. The archive feature itself (not the plan) is archivo. Lowercase 'premium feature/account' → función premium / cuenta premium.

avoid: Actualizar (alone, where it reads as update/refresh)
terms.note: 'Actualizar a Premium' is a common software convention and tolerated; new proposals use Mejorar a / Pásate a.

terms.use: Preferencias (for NewsBlur's Preferences) / Configuración or Ajustes (for Settings)
terms.note: Both Ajustes (iOS/Android es-ES) and Configuración (es-419) are standard system words; do not churn between them. Preferences is always Preferencias.
Sentence case.

avoid: Todas las historias del sitio (= all stories of one site)
terms.note: It means stories from all sites, not all stories of this site.

Stories from sites that publish rarely (below a stories-per-month threshold); the stories are not infrequent and it is not one site. 'Infrequent stories per month' (the threshold setting) → Umbral de artículos al mes / Máximo de artículos al mes.

terms.concept: Widely Read / Long Reads / Good Reads / Global Shared
terms.use: Artículos muy leídos / Lecturas largas / Buenas lecturas / Artículos compartidos globalmente
terms.note: Good Reads is a folder of good stories, not books.

Briefing slots are 8:30 / 12:30 / 17:00: Mañana / Mediodía / Tarde, titles Resumen de la mañana / del mediodía / de la tarde (catch-up 2026-10-15). 'Brief' (summary length next to Medium/Detailed) → Breve. 'Editorial' (narrative style) → Editorial.
Email newsletters → boletines por correo electrónico.
Friends tabs: I'm Following → A quién sigo; Following Me → Quién me sigue (must be distinguishable). Plain 'Following' count label → Siguiendo.
Unmute → Dejar de silenciar (or Reactivar in tight space).

terms.use: Vista de feed / Vista de texto / Vista de artículo / Vista original
terms.note: Original site → Sitio original.

avoid: Pregúntale a la IA (as a feature label)
terms.note: Catalog plurality (22 vs 11 English). In prose: la función Preguntar a la IA.

terms.use: cuenta / Iniciar sesión / Cerrar sesión / Registrarse or Crear cuenta
terms.note: Sign up as a call to action may be Regístrate.

terms.use: correo electrónico (correo in tight space) / contraseña

terms.note: Premium trial → prueba de Premium / prueba Premium.
Feature name in sentence case: Feeds web.
Clustered story → artículo agrupado; clúster is tolerated but grupo is preferred in UI labels.
Pulsa is also correct; do not churn.

terms.use: ¿…? ¡…!, sentence case, «…» for quotes the English adds
avoid: English Title Case in labels (Siguiente Historia No Leída)
terms.note: Keep ASCII quotes only where the English has them (the build forbids adding new ones). Ellipsis follows the English (… or ...).
Site-freshness badges: 'Stale %s' takes a month and year (mar 2024), so 'Inactivo desde %s'; 'Stale — updated %s' → 'Inactivo — actualizado %s'.

'beats' → gana a (GANA A in caps); 'Positive?' → ¿Seguro?; the like/dislike words inserted into 'What do you %(like)s and %(dislike)s about this site?' are 'me gusta'/'no me gusta', so the template is '¿Qué %(like)s y qué %(dislike)s de este sitio?'.

terms.use: web and Android: Todo / No leído / Enfoque; iOS: Todos / No leído / Enfoque
avoid: Todas / Sin leer / No leídas (not the shown labels)
terms.note: 'Switch to All or Unread' names the labels exactly as each platform shows them: 'Cambia a Todo o No leído.' (iOS: 'Cambia a Todos o No leído.').

terms.use: count first, singular noun for one
avoid: el feed %1$d / el sitio %@ (count read as a name)
plural noun in the one form
terms.note: Several one forms put the count after the noun or kept the plural; fix them to '%@ sitio', 'Añadir %1$d feed…'.
